Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

Face: broad oval face; full cheeks and sharply defined brows; short rounded nose, wide mouth; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: brown-chestnut, bun-topknot-wrapped, deliberate accent: architectural high knot. Wardrobe: short-jacket-trousers, specifically a shaped short jacket, practical closures, generous trousers, and low boots; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette moss-ivory. Maintenance cue: immaculate clothes over weathered hands. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a folded handkerchief only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
